AboutPage.subtitle: Four focused companies. Two core markets. One commitment to making everyday life smarter, healthier and more sustainable.

story.title: From one vision to four innovative companies.
story.p1: NEAMAT GLOBAL was founded with a simple belief: the services people rely on every day — clean water, well-kept homes, reliable property and modern technology — deserve world-class standards.
story.p2: Headquartered in Riyadh with operations in Bangladesh, we build and operate businesses that share one design system, one culture and one promise: solutions, people and progress, together.
story.badgeLabel: Core markets connected by one vision

vision.text: Become the most trusted diversified group in the region — and grow from Saudi Arabia and Bangladesh to new markets worldwide.
